title: Cloud Developer
description:
RockX is a digital asset services platform that aims to unlock the full value of digital assets and decentralised governance mechanisms for token holders and those seeking to enter the digital asset market. By providing sophisticated services for cryptocurrency markets, RockX will drive the mass adoption of digital assets while accelerating the development of public blockchains and their ecosystems. Initially launching with a secure Staking-as-a-Service platform, RockX plans to roll out additional services and products to serve as a trusted one-stop platform for all market participants.

It was founded by entrepreneurs with a diverse background in economics, finance, and technology and years of experience in the blockchain ecosystem. The company is looking for a highly motivated blockchain engineer to participate in the project to build a world-class blockchain staking platform.

We provide competitive salaries and benefits, a flexible, creative, and agile working environment, and exposure to the latest technologies. The role is a full-time remote position

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, build and test the automated application in Cloud Native environment.

  • Build up CI/CD pipelines and effective monitoring system

  • Everything as code to create elegant automation tools with various tools

  • Document the design, implementation and other work-related stuffs 

  • Work closely with other engineers to provide secure and reliable services

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or other relevant disciplines

  • At least one year of experience as a Developer or Cloud Engineer

  • Familiar with any cloud provider, preferably AWS

  • Familiar with tools like AWS CLI, GitHub Action, Terraform or other equivalents

  • Experience with Linux is a plus

  • Experience in any programming language, such as Golang or NodeJS is preferred

  • Knowledge of PoS based blockchain protocols, such as ETH2.0, Substrate or Cosmos is a plus

  • Can-do mindset, critical thinking and pursuit of engineering excellence

  • Being both a great individual programmer and a great team player
